decisions.reason: Flagship product remains strategically aligned with reusable agricultural logistics, though its niche market limits growth.
Foldable large containers are a core returnable packaging line with broad customer appeal and efficiency benefits.
Rackable pallets are essential in logistics, but the medium-duty line faces strong competition and may be rationalized later.
Spill-retention pallets meet safety and environmental regulations, supporting customer compliance and sustainability.
Load-retaining pallets improve load stability and reduce damage, aligning with supply-chain efficiency goals.
